The PawPal promise

Trust isn't a badge. It's a system.

🪪

Identity checks

Planned verification of caregiver identity and relevant experience before approval.

🧩

Better matching

Match pet temperament, needs and routine with caregiver suitability.

📲

Visible care

Check-ins, feeding notes, visit photos and completion summaries.

🛟

Issue escalation

Clear incident reporting, support and caregiver quality review processes.

These are proposed operating standards for PawPal, not claims that a live network is already verified.

Frequently asked questions

Curious? We've got you.

Can I book a real caregiver here?

Not yet. This is a functional front-end prototype for the PawPal pitch. Booking requests are saved only in your browser and are not sent to a provider.

How will PawPal verify caregivers?

Our proposed model includes identity screening, reference and experience checks, onboarding standards, ongoing feedback and issue escalation. These processes must be implemented before launch.

Will I receive real-time photos and feeding notes?

The dashboard demonstrates the intended experience. Live updates require a connected caregiver application, backend and authenticated accounts.

Are the map locations actual PawPal centres?

No. The map displays real geographic areas, not verified PawPal centres. Nearby business discovery links to Google Maps search.
